installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Next.js App Installation Script
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt update
apt install -y curl unzip git

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${PACKAGE_MANAGER}" = "pnpm" ]; then
    echo "Enabling Corepack and pnpm..."
    corepack enable
    corepack prepare pnpm@${PNPM_VERSION:-10.12.1} --activate

    echo "Installing Nodejs Packages"
    if [[ ! -z ${NODE_PACKAGES} ]]; then
        pnpm add ${NODE_PACKAGES}
    fi

    echo "Installing dependencies..."
    pnpm install
else
    echo "Updating NPM..."
    npm install npm@latest -g

    echo "Installing Nodejs Packages"
    if [[ ! -z ${NODE_PACKAGES} ]]; then
        npm install ${NODE_PACKAGES}
    fi

    echo "Installing dependencies..."
    npm install
fi

echo "Install Complete"
exit 0
